lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity white spots arranged in roughly vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills, forming a semi-regular 2D grid along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of lighter pixel intensity intersect with the larger high-luminance blobs to create a structured grid of nodes across the central flank region.

other_distinctive_markers: A significant variance in pixel cluster size is observed between the pectoral fin (small, high-density spotting) and the main lateral flank (larger, lower-density node-based spotting).
